assumptions: Claude Code applies a project's .claude/settings.json env block to plugin-spawned MCP server processes — the issue author's own proposal relies on this and their environment demonstrates the settings surface; server-side behavior is verified independently of it.
context: Implemented #46: TWINING_PROJECT env var for shared stores — resolution --project arg > env > cwd (relative env values resolve against cwd), plugin 1.17.0 drops its hardcoded --project . which would have shadowed the env var. Verified end-to-end with the built binary.
rationale: the issue's proposed precedence (arg > env > cwd) is correct, but the plugin's hardcoded --project . would have permanently shadowed the env var for exactly the server the issue targets; cwd default is behavior-identical when the var is unset. Rejected shell-expanding ${TWINING_PROJECT:-.} inside the plugin's sh -lc string — works today but buries resolution logic in a shell one-liner instead of one canonical, testable code path.
summary: Chose to pair the server-side TWINING_PROJECT support with removing --project . from the plugin launch command
